entries.name: Edgar Markov
entries.notes: Retro (1997) frame reprint, Innistrad Remastered. Sharp in-focus capture, baked upright. Name reads cleanly and the collector number 428 now parses off the copyright line, but sibling inr #328 (showcase Edgar Markov) is one collector digit away with no set code on the retro frame, so name+number correctly surfaces a picker (precision guard) rather than auto-accepting; on-device the set-symbol matcher settles retro vs showcase. Provided as a plain Camera-app photo after the GrimoraScry harness export failed on-device.

entries.name: Edgar Markov
entries.notes: Same card, out-of-focus bulk-scan field capture (the original failing scan). The title is too soft to auto-corroborate, but the copyright-line collector number 428 survives the blur and parses, so it recovers to a picker with inr 428 present rather than resolving to nothing. Documents the field failure that motivated the tap-to-focus rebuild; kept as a blurry robustness data point alongside the sharp entry.
